metadata.title: Stylized Red Eye on Black Background

recipe.visualDefinition: A highly stylized, abstract illustration of an eye, rendered in a vibrant red color against a solid black background. The eye features a central pupil composed of concentric circles, an iris, and distinct, blocky 'eyelashes' extending from both the upper and lower lids. The overall aesthetic suggests a hand-drawn or primitive art style, with slight imperfections and a textured appearance.
coreVisualRelationships: The red eye is the sole focal point against the stark black background.
Concentric circles form the pupil, drawing attention to the center of the eye.
Blocky, irregular 'eyelashes' frame the eye, adding to its stylized nature.
The vibrant red contrasts sharply with the deep black, creating a high-impact visual.
coreInvariants: The eye must be the central and dominant element.
The color scheme must be primarily red on black.
The stylized, somewhat crude, hand-drawn aesthetic of the eye must be maintained.
The concentric circles for the pupil are essential.
The blocky 'eyelashes' are a defining characteristic.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The stylized red eye is centrally placed, occupying approximately 40-50% of the image height and width, making it the dominant visual element.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The concentric circles forming the pupil act as the primary visual anchor, drawing the viewer's gaze directly to the center of the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye's central position and the concentric circles create a direct, inward eye path. The 'eyelashes' provide a secondary, outward radiating movement.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space, consisting of the solid black background, surrounds the red eye, emphasizing its isolation and impact. The negative space is balanced on all sides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The black background serves as the dominant color, providing a stark, deep canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The vibrant red of the eye acts as the primary contrast color, creating a powerful and attention-grabbing focal point.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: None, as the design is minimalist with only two main colors.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The red is highly saturated and bright, standing out dramatically against the very low-value, desaturated black background.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to red and black.
The red should be a bold, primary red, not muted or dark.
The black should be a deep, true black.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A sans-serif typeface with a relatively high x-height and moderate stroke contrast.
letterConstructionRules: Stroke endings are blunt and unadorned.

composition.position: bottom right corner, aligned to the right and bottom edges
composition.scale: small, secondary to the main graphic
composition.relationshipToImage: positioned as a legal disclaimer, separate from the main graphic

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The minimalist, functional sans-serif text provides a stark, legible contrast to the expressive, illustrative main graphic.
graphicDevices: A small, rectangular outline box around the 'ADVISORY' text.

preserve: All-caps typesetting for the entire block.
Small scale relative to the main graphic.

candidateDirections.reason: Offers a bold, condensed sans-serif look with high legibility, suitable for a warning label.
Provides a clean, all-caps, condensed sans-serif aesthetic that matches the required visual characteristics.
A strong, condensed sans-serif that would maintain the tight, impactful feel of the original text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black background. On this background, create a stylized, abstract eye illustration in a vibrant red color. The eye should have a central pupil made of concentric circles and distinct, blocky 'eyelashes' extending from both the upper and lower lids. The style should appear somewhat hand-drawn or primitive, with slight imperfections in the lines. Position the eye centrally, occupying approximately 40-50% of the canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the bottom right corner, add a small text block. The first line should read 'PARENTAL', followed by 'ADVISORY' in a slightly larger, bolder font, enclosed in a thin rectangular outline. Below this, add 'EXPLICIT CONTENT'. All text should be in white, all-caps, condensed sans-serif, with tight tracking and leading. Align the text block to the right and bottom edges of the canvas.

verificationChecks: Is the eye illustration the sole dominant graphic element?
Is the eye rendered in a vibrant red against a deep black background?
Does the eye feature concentric circles for the pupil and blocky 'eyelashes'?
Is the text small, white, all-caps, and in a condensed sans-serif?
Is the text positioned in the bottom right corner?
Is the 'ADVISORY' text enclosed in a small rectangular outline?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of red (as long as it remains vibrant and high-contrast).
Subtle variations in the 'hand-drawn' texture of the eye.
Specific dimensions of the eye, as long as it remains the dominant element.
Exact font for the advisory text, as long as it meets the specified anatomical and typesetting criteria.
mustRedesign: Any deviation from the red-on-black color scheme for the main graphic.
Changing the stylized, hand-drawn aesthetic of the eye.
Altering the concentric circle pupil or blocky eyelashes.
Using a serif or script font for the advisory text.
Significantly changing the position or scale of the eye or text.

mustAchieve: A strong, impactful visual contrast between the red eye and black background.
A clear, recognizable, yet abstract representation of an eye.
A sense of raw, unrefined energy from the illustration style.
Legible and appropriately scaled advisory text.
avoid: Overly realistic or detailed eye rendering.
Smooth, perfectly geometric lines for the eye illustration.
Text that is difficult to read or disproportionately large/small.

postGenerationChecks: Verify the red eye is the central and most prominent feature.
Confirm the color palette is strictly red and black for the main graphic.
Ensure the eye's stylized, hand-drawn quality with concentric pupil and blocky lashes is present.
Check that the advisory text is white, all-caps, condensed sans-serif, and correctly positioned.
